calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Ncontracts
calls.summary: N Contracts is exploring new A/B testing tools to overcome constraints faced with their current HubSpot setup, which limits their measurement capabilities to bounce rates and embedded form submissions. They require a platform that supports multiple goal types and complex tests, including multi-page tests and JavaScript-based experiments, while integrating developer input for improved flexibility. GrowthBook, an open-source solution, offers features like feature flags for controlled rollouts and supports testing multiple variants with robust statistical analysis. However, it currently lacks native HubSpot or Salesforce integrations, although the team expressed interest in a potential product analytics feature expected in April. As N Contracts evaluates GrowthBook, they are interested in a hands-on trial to assess fit and capabilities.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation platform, marketing analytics, developer collaboration, GrowthBook
